observation: Architecture critique was exceptionally thorough (2 rounds, 8.5/10 avg). Critique Round 1 identified both load-bearing wiring gaps (bun-in-CI, discoverStories-in-Node). Round 2 verified all claims against tree. No surprises in review; approved plan's wiring was sound.

Vacuous-gate shipped with silent skip: 57% of catalog (39/69 components) skipped without assertion. 34 components had zero baselines. Root: race condition in hash-route navigation + non-deterministic `.count()` reads. The `if (sections.length === 0) { console.warn(...); continue; }` pattern is a silent-regression mode.

Cross-platform baseline blessing error: builder blessed on Mac, CI (Linux) failed on 1px dimension mismatch (AI2/DialogPortalRoot 160px Mac vs 161px Linux). maxDiffPixelRatio only covers color diffs on same-size images. Plan explicitly said 'CI/Linux is the blessing authority' + 'never commit Mac PNGs' — guidance was not followed.

Plan-critical mitigations stated as principles, not pre-task checkpoints. Critique flagged cross-platform risk as highest. Plan included 'canonical platform: CI/Linux' mitigation. Builder did not execute it during Task 3. Root: the mitigation was principle-level (canonical platform is Linux) not action-level (bless in Docker container before committing).

Review cycle cost: 3 rounds over ~14h (vacuous-gate caught in round 1, cross-platform error caught in round 2, final validation in round 3). Two avoidable review cycles: (1) coverage guard + allowlist would have caught vacuous-gate in red phase, (2) pre-task Docker blessing would have caught platform error before Task 3 commit.
